stop_condition.action: The entrypoint stops without running once 14 observation refs exist; the maintainer then disables the Routine.

removal_path: Disable the Routine, delete this spec, run_severity_observation.py, severity-observation.md and their tests; keep the claude/severity-observation-* refs until #653 has read them.
